title: Minecraft Dungeons
provenance: Reported by EdoardoSgherri (highball-db#707, 2026-10-26), Apple M1 Pro, macOS 15.7.3, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, msync, vcrun2022, rated 3 of 5 after 9 minutes: the game itself runs perfectly, but the Microsoft account sign-in is asked again at every start and often never gets past its 'Let's Go' step. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Runs well once signed in, on the default engine with DXMT on an M1 Pro. The game signs in with a Microsoft account through Xbox's sign-in, and on the default Wine 10 engine Wine forgets that sign-in at every start: its credential lookup fails on macOS when the Keychain holds no match, so the Xbox sign-in never finds its saved key. Highball's Wine 11 engines carry the fix (engine patch 0019, made for Forza Horizon 6), and the recipe makes Play offer that engine. Not yet confirmed with this game. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: The Microsoft account sign-in comes back at every start, and its 'Let's Go' step often does not go through (default engine)
knownIssues.cause: Wine's CredEnumerateW fails on macOS when the Keychain has no match, so Xbox's sign-in never finds the key it saved (the same bug as Forza Horizon 6 and Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024)
knownIssues.fix: the Wine 11 engine (r18 or newer), which the recipe offers on Play. By hand, the environment's settings, Advanced, Engine. On the sign-in pages, hold a button for about half a second rather than a quick click, and switch apps and back if a page sits
